subject: Scout Integrations — Enablement Warm Start & Sandbox Runbook
messages:
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@scout-integrations.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Scout / Redwood — warm start onboarding request

Hi David,

Thanks again for the intro at the Summit — excited to move this forward. Scout Integrations is targeting a light "warm start" onboarding with Redwood for an upcoming POC we have with a regulated healthcare client. High-level ask: a focused 2-week enablement that gets our solution engineers ramped on Redwood Private (VPC), a sandbox we can run small evals on, and a short runbook for go-live gating (security evidence, logs, basic fallback flows).

Proposed timing: week of Oct 20 (two half-days + async prep) — flexible if Redwood prefers earlier.

I've attached a draft SOW and a one-sheet that outlines our P0 use cases and expected monthly tokens. Quick answers to things you might ask:
- Primary contact: me (Alyssa) and Gabe Ross (copied).
- Prefer Private deployment for this customer (data residency / compliance).
- Expected footprint for POC: ~2M tokens/month.

Can you confirm Redwood can provide a sandbox workspace and a short checklist for what we need to deliver pre-kickoff? Also, who from Redwood should we loop in for enablement and security coordination?

Thanks,
Alyssa Torres
Head of Partnerships | Scout Integrations
Attachments: scout-sow-draft.docx
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@scout-integrations.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scout / Redwood — warm start onboarding request

Hi Alyssa — great to hear from you and glad the Summit intro was useful.

We can absolutely run a two-week warm-start program and provision a sandbox workspace in a customer-dedicated VPC for the POC. I'll own coordination. Looping in Marissa (Partner Enablement) and Soojin (Solutions Engineering) to scope the technical plan and schedule.

A few quick clarifying items so we scope correctly:
- Do you want Redwood-managed private sandbox credentials (we host the control plane but VPC peering) or a self-managed on-prem agent? For most SI-led POCs we recommend Redwood Private with a short lived sandbox credential set.
- Can you share a short prompt set and 2–3 sample requests for the P0 use cases (we'll use these for baseline evals)?
- Please confirm whether the 2M tokens/month estimate is for the single POC tenant or aggregate across Scout customers — affects the sandbox quota and recommended model variant.

Suggested high-level agenda for the enablement:
1) Pre-kickoff: asset collection (prompts, sample data, SSO/Kerberos info if needed).
2) Day 1 (2-hour workshop): architecture, private deployment overview, auth/KMS, and security checklist.
3) Day 3 (2-hour workshop): integration patterns, streaming, KV cache expectations, and latency tuning.
4) Async: runbook handoff, test prompts, and regression checklist.

I'll put together a short runbook and a one-page warm-start checklist and share a Drive folder. Proposed kickoff: Oct 21 10:00–12:00 PT for day 1. Does that work?

Thanks — David
David Kim
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Torres <alyssa@scout-integrations.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Scout / Redwood — warm start onboarding request

David — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Marissa and Soojin. Oct 21 10:00–12:00 PT works for Day 1.

Answers:
- Sandbox: Redwood-managed private sandbox creds preferred (helps speed internal approvals).
- Prompt set: attaching a short prompt pack (P0_prompts.txt) and the PM's prioritized use-case doc.
- Token estimate: 2M tokens/month is our conservative estimate for this single POC tenant. We may scale later.

I've attached an SI-warmstart-checklist.xlsx that has our internal prerequisites (SSO, contact list, compliance owner). We'll also need a short list of required security artifacts (SOC 2 scope, encryption at rest, audit log samples). Gabe will start the security PSQ but wants to sync with your security engineer next week.

Attaching: SI-warmstart-checklist.xlsx (please confirm receipt)

Best,
Alyssa

Subject: Scout Integrations — proposed warm start execution plan (internal)

Marissa / Soojin — quick internal note to align before we reply to Scout. Key asks and proposed owners: 

Goal: Two-week warm start focused on Redwood Private sandbox, security artifacts, and an enablement runbook that lets Scout deliver the POC.

Owners / tasks:
- David (me): project owner and partner PM; schedule workshops and finalize SOW redlines.
- Marissa: enablement lead — create Day 1/Day 3 slide decks, one-page runbook, and post-workshop checklist.
- Soojin: SE lead — sandbox provisioning checklist, baseline prompt evals, and latency/cost baseline run.
- Security coordination: loop in security@redwoodinference.com for artifact exchange (SOC 2, KMS details).

Deliverables (tentative):
- Shared Drive (folder): runbook, prompt eval results, sandbox creds (expiration noted), SOW redline doc.
- Warm-start checklist spreadsheet (we'll merge with Scout's SI-warmstart-checklist.xlsx).

Timing: send Scout a confirmation email today (Oct 3) that Oct 21 Day 1 is booked and include a Drive link + HubSpot record. Also confirm that Scout will get sandbox creds ~3 business days before Day 1.

I'll draft the reply and loop Security as a blind cc if needed for artifact exchange. Any changes?

Thanks,
David
